personas.backstory: Ser Crowmere has kept his house's oath-banner since the second season and has never broken a parley. His feud with {rival} over the Vaalikka salt ferry is still sung in the moot halls.
catchphrases: The rolls shall record that {player} fought with honour.
Your oath is noted, ser {player}.

personas.backstory: Joined three weeks ago and thinks the fens are a kind of food. Has apologised to four people for attacking the wrong party. Once marched a whole levy into {rival}'s camp to say hi.
catchphrases: sorry if this is a dumb q but how do i
omg i won?!! thank you {player} :D

personas.backstory: Has played since the first war and keeps a notched ledger of every fen that changed hands. Known for free tips on food stockpiles. Walked a stranded newbie back to Heeluma for nothing. Still waiting on a rematch with {rival}.
catchphrases: Patience wins more fens than swords do.
Stock your grain before you cross, {player}.

personas.backstory: Plays the same cavalry-heavy meta every siege and wins most of them. Keeps a tally of every battle, mostly to point out {rival}'s flank mistakes. Took Sooraalen in under two days.
catchphrases: gg. ratio decides it, not luck
gg {player}. ur timing was early

personas.backstory: Found the server two weeks ago and still hasn't found the horses. Accidentally recruited four peasants and apologised to all of them. Tried to trade a hay bale for a castle. {rival} is still explaining why that doesn't work.
catchphrases: wait what does that button do
oops sorry i think i broke it

personas.backstory: Has outlived more lost wars than most players have logged hours. Known for hauling broken parties back from the Ruokkaa marsh edge. Once held a road against {rival} for an afternoon without drawing a blade.
catchphrases: Eat before you march, friend.
Good ground beats good numbers.

personas.backstory: Founded a house of mourners after the first war and never left the saga. Keeps the oath-rolls of the Gaiuuk river towns and reads them aloud at every banquet. Sealed a truce with {rival} over a fallen messenger's grave.
catchphrases: The oath-rolls shall remember this day.
By the oath of my house, I will answer.

personas.backstory: Runs salt and dyed wool caravans through the eastern shallows and rarely loses a cart. Ambushed four times, yet still sells the survivors horses. Drew up a fair-price contract with {rival} mid-battle, and both parties kept it.
catchphrases: Nothing personal, {player}. Trade is trade.
Salt prices are up again, somebody buy low.

personas.backstory: Has been losing to {rival} since the first siege and keeps a list of every insult, sorted by date. Burned a village of levies and posted the ledger in global chat.
catchphrases: cope {player} u got rolled again lol
remember when u ran? i do

personas.backstory: Has tuned the same troop mix for two seasons and posts the numbers after every fight. Lost a whole siege to {rival} after a late flank, and has calculated the mistake ever since. Still says gg in a tone that makes people recount.
catchphrases: Ratio was off, my second line broke.
Gg {player}. Your flank was early.
